script.flip1: Detroit hangs around or leads, keeps the Gibbs 22-to-29 carry plan, and both passing games fall short of what 54.5 promises. That flip kills a Gibbs rush under and also cuts the extra LaPorta targets that a trailing script would add.
script.flip2: Buffalo jumps ahead early, Detroit abandons the run, Allen and Cook milk clock, and a two-score game trims late snaps for D.J. Moore, Dalton Kincaid and Khalil Shakir. A 5.5 spread is only a moderate blowout flag, so this is a flip, not the base.
